zh-CN.title: 用 iPhone 或 iPad 控制 Mac：四步连接与排障
zh-CN.seoTitle: 用 iPhone / iPad 控制 Mac：连接、权限与排障 | NinoPad
zh-CN.description: 在局域网内把 iPhone 或 iPad 连到 Mac，作为触控板和快捷键面板使用。四步完成扫码配对，配置辅助功能与屏幕录制权限，并按症状排查连接问题。
intro: 在同一局域网下，NinoPad 可将 iPhone 或 iPad 变成 Mac 的触控板、键盘和快捷键面板。完成配对后先验证光标移动；需要查看电脑屏幕时，再开启屏幕镜像。

answerPoints.title: 两端安装
answerPoints.text: 手机安装 App，Mac 安装免费配套端。

answerPoints.title: 局域网互通
answerPoints.text: 首次连接用同一普通 Wi-Fi；不支持外网远程。

answerPoints.title: 分步授权
answerPoints.text: 控制输入开启辅助功能，查看画面开启屏幕录制。

zh-CN.requirements: iOS / iPadOS 17+ · macOS 13+ · Apple Silicon / Intel

sections.title: 四步完成连接并验证光标

items.title: 安装双端软件
items.text: 在 App Store 下载 NinoPad。Mac 从官方 GitHub Releases 下载并打开 .dmg，将 App 拖入“应用程序”后启动。

items.title: 展示 Mac 配对码
items.text: 确保两端连接同一 Wi-Fi。点击 Mac 菜单栏猫咪图标，打开配对二维码窗口。

items.title: 手机扫码配对
items.text: 在 App“设备”页面点击“扫描二维码连接”，或在附近设备中选择 Mac 并输入 6 位配对码。

items.title: 授予权限并测试
items.text: 根据 Mac 端指引开启辅助功能权限。在手机触控板区域滑动并轻点，确认 Mac 光标正常响应。

blocks.label: 如何确认连接成功？
blocks.text: 手指在手机上滑动时 Mac 光标同步移动，即表示基础输入已接通。若画面黑屏，先检查屏幕录制权限，无需重新配对。

sections.title: 输入与画面权限彼此独立

blocks.text: Mac：系统设置 → 隐私与安全性。iPhone / iPad：在系统设置里找到 NinoPad，检查对应权限。

rows: 控制光标移动、鼠标点击、键盘输入与快捷键触发。
仅用于向移动端传输 Mac 画面。在部分系统版本中显示为“屏幕与系统音频录制”。
用于在局域网内发现 Mac 并建立通信连接。
扫描配对二维码时需要。手动输入 6 位配对码无需相机权限。

blocks.label: 优先调通输入权限
blocks.text: 仅使用触控板或快捷键时无需开启屏幕录制。若 macOS 提示重启配套端，按提示退出后重新打开，让新权限生效。

sections.title: 功能使用：触控板、快捷键与画面镜像

items.title: 触控板操作
items.text: 支持单指移动光标、单指轻点点击、双指滑动滚轮。初次使用请对照 Mac 屏幕测试。

items.title: 文字与快捷键
items.text: 先点击激活 Mac 目标窗口再发送文本。自定义快捷键面板建议先添加常用按键。

items.title: 屏幕镜像
items.text: 开启屏幕录制权限后在设备连接页启动共享，支持切换全屏。输入与画面建议分开验证。

sections.title: 常见问题排查与解决方法

items.question: 搜不到 Mac 设备
items: 确认 Mac 配套端正在运行，且手机已开启“本地网络”权限。
尝试直接扫描 Mac 端二维码。公共网络或访客 Wi-Fi 可能隔离设备，换普通家庭 Wi-Fi 验证。

items.question: 扫码后连接超时
items: 唤醒 Mac 屏幕，重新打开配套端的配对二维码窗口。
确认两台设备在局域网内能互相通信；公司网络可能限制设备互访。

items.question: 显示已连接，但光标和按键无反应
items: 进入 Mac 系统设置，确认“辅助功能”列表已勾选当前运行的配套端应用。
退出并重新打开配套端，在空白文本文档中测试光标移动、点击和文字输入。

items.question: 可以正常控制，但画面黑屏或卡住
items: 检查 Mac 端的“屏幕录制”权限已开启，并在 App 内打开屏幕共享开关。
重启 Mac 配套端，切换电脑当前窗口，观察移动端画面是否恢复刷新。

items.question: 文字输入发送到了错误窗口
items: 在 Mac 上用鼠标直接点击目标文档或输入框以聚焦光标。
先发送 1 到 2 个字符确认焦点正确，再发送长段文字。

items.question: 连接在使用过程中意外中断
items: 检查 Mac 是否进入睡眠状态、配套端是否意外退出，或 Wi-Fi 网络是否发生切换。
确保网络连通后重新连接。若频繁断连，请记录两端系统版本、App 版本及断开时的具体操作。

sections.title: 基础功能免费，按需升级 Pro

blocks.text: 基础键盘、核心系统控制和 Mac 配套端完全免费。Pro 用于解锁专业工作台、动态壁纸与独立乐器等高级模块，具体以 App 内说明为准。升级 Pro 并不能解决网络配对或系统权限配置问题。

faq.question: 外出时可以用蜂窝网络远程控制家里的 Mac 吗？
faq.answer: 不支持。本应用基于局域网直连设计，两台设备必须处于同一可互通的本地网络，不提供公网远程中转服务。

faq.question: Mac 连接有线网线、手机连接 Wi-Fi 可以正常使用吗？
faq.answer: 可以，只要有线与无线网络属于同一可互通的局域网。若首次连接失败，建议将两端都连至同一 Wi-Fi 进行测试。

faq.question: 仅使用触控板和按键控制，需要开启屏幕录制权限吗？
faq.answer: 不需要。光标和按键控制仅需“辅助功能”权限。“屏幕录制”权限仅在需要将 Mac 画面实时同步到手机或平板时才需要开启。

faq.question: iPad 会在本地直接运行 Mac 软件吗？
faq.answer: 不会。所有 Mac 软件均在 Mac 本地计算运行，iPad 仅负责发送操作指令和显示同步画面。

en.title: Control Your Mac from iPhone or iPad: Four-Step Setup and Troubleshooting
en.seoTitle: Control Mac from iPhone or iPad: Setup, Permissions & Troubleshooting | NinoPad
en.description: Turn your iPhone or iPad into a Mac trackpad and shortcut keypad in four steps. Pair via QR code, configure Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions, and resolve connection issues.
intro: NinoPad turns your iPhone or iPad into a trackpad, keyboard, and shortcut keypad for your Mac over a shared local network. Connect and verify cursor movement first, then enable screen mirroring when you need to view the Mac display.
en.answerTitle: Three Things to Check Before Connecting

answerPoints.title: Install Both Apps
answerPoints.text: Get the mobile app and the free Mac companion.

answerPoints.title: Use the Same Network
answerPoints.text: Connect both devices to regular Wi-Fi. Internet remote access is not supported.

answerPoints.title: Grant Permissions in Order
answerPoints.text: Accessibility controls input; Screen Recording streams the display.

en.requirements: iOS / iPadOS 17+ · macOS 13+ · Apple Silicon / Intel

sections.title: Connect in Four Steps and Test the Cursor

items.title: Install both apps
items.text: Install NinoPad from the App Store. On Mac, open the .dmg from official GitHub Releases, drag NinoPad into Applications, then launch it.

items.title: Display the pairing code
items.text: Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi. Click the cat icon in the Mac menu bar to open the QR code window.

items.title: Scan with your phone
items.text: Open the mobile Devices view and choose QR code pairing, or select your Mac from nearby devices and enter its six-digit code.

items.title: Grant access and test
items.text: Follow the Mac prompts to grant Accessibility permission. Open a trackpad workspace on your phone, swipe and tap to test cursor response.

blocks.label: How do you know it worked?
blocks.text: If the Mac cursor follows your finger, input is working. If the screen preview is black, check Screen Recording permission instead of pairing again.

sections.title: Input and Screen Viewing Use Separate Permissions

blocks.text: On Mac, open System Settings → Privacy & Security. On iPhone or iPad, find NinoPad in Settings and check the required permissions.

rows: Required for cursor navigation, mouse clicks, keyboard entry, and keyboard shortcuts.
Required only to stream the Mac screen to your mobile device. Named Screen & System Audio Recording on some macOS versions.
Required to discover the Mac and establish local network communication.
Required to scan the pairing QR code. Manual 6-digit code entry does not require camera access.

blocks.label: Verify input first
blocks.text: Trackpad and keypad features do not require Screen Recording. If macOS prompts you to restart the companion app, quit and reopen it for changes to take effect.

sections.title: Using Trackpad, Shortcuts, and Screen Mirroring

items.title: Trackpad
items.text: Move with one finger, tap to click, and scroll with two fingers. Test while watching your Mac screen.

items.title: Text & Shortcuts
items.text: Click into the target Mac window before sending text. Start your custom keypad with two or three frequent shortcuts.

items.title: Screen Mirroring
items.text: Enable Screen Recording, then toggle screen sharing in the device tab. Verify input control and display streaming separately.

items.question: Mac does not appear in device list
items: Verify the Mac companion app is active and mobile Local Network permission is enabled.
Scan the Mac QR code directly. Guest Wi-Fi and public networks may isolate devices; test on a regular home Wi-Fi network.

items.question: QR code pairing times out
items: Wake your Mac and reopen the QR code window from the running companion app.
Confirm the devices can reach one another on the local network. Enterprise policies may restrict device-to-device traffic.

items.question: Connected, but cursor and keys do not respond
items: Verify Accessibility permission is granted to the currently running companion application in Mac System Settings.
Restart the companion app if prompted, then test cursor movement, clicks, and a short test phrase in a blank document.

items.question: Control works, but the screen is black or frozen
items: Check that Mac Screen Recording permission is enabled and screen sharing is turned on in the mobile app.
Restart the Mac companion app, switch active windows on the Mac, and check if the mobile stream updates.

items.question: Text appears in the wrong window
items: Click the target document or input field on your Mac to place cursor focus.
Send a short test word to confirm active focus before transmitting longer text.

items.question: Connection drops intermittently
items: Check whether your Mac entered sleep mode, the companion app closed, or your Wi-Fi network changed.
Reconnect on the shared network. If drops persist, note your OS versions, app versions, and the exact step where failure occurs.

sections.title: Start with Free Features Before Upgrading to Pro

blocks.text: The basic keypad, core system controls, and the Mac companion app are completely free. Pro unlocks advanced workspaces, dynamic wallpapers, and standalone instruments, as indicated in the app. Upgrading to Pro will not resolve local network or permission configuration issues.

faq.question: Can I control my Mac remotely over cellular data while away from home?
faq.answer: No. NinoPad operates over a direct local network connection. Both devices must be on the same local network; cloud relay and internet remote desktop are not supported.

faq.question: Can the Mac use Ethernet while the phone is on Wi-Fi?
faq.answer: Yes, as long as the wired and wireless connections can reach each other on the same local network. If pairing fails initially, connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi to test.

faq.question: Does trackpad and keypad control require Screen Recording permission?
faq.answer: No. Input control requires only Accessibility permission. Screen Recording is used exclusively when streaming the Mac display to your mobile device.

faq.question: Does the iPad run Mac software locally?
faq.answer: No. All Mac software runs entirely on the Mac. The iPad only transmits input commands and displays the mirrored screen.
